text: Replace this file with your own held-out prompt set. The rows below are a starting scaffold, NOT the real harness input. The single most valuable thing you can add is prompts you have personally watched the IQ3_XXS build circle on -- tag those with known_trigger: true and they get reported as a separate subset, because an aggregate over easy prompts hides a regression on the hard ones.

Six people (Ana, Ben, Cal, Dee, Eli, Fay) must be assigned to three two-person shifts. Ana will not work with Ben. Cal must work either the first or last shift. Dee and Eli must be on consecutive shifts. Fay cannot take the first shift. Enumerate every valid assignment, then state how many there are.
Write a sentence that contains exactly three instances of the letter 'e', exactly two commas, and exactly seven words. Verify your answer by counting, and revise if it fails.

Prove or disprove: every continuous function on a closed interval that takes both positive and negative values has exactly one root. If the claim is false as stated, identify the minimal additional hypothesis that makes it true.

A service returns 200 with an empty body about 1% of the time under load, but never in staging. Logs show no errors. Walk through the diagnosis, stating what you would rule out at each step and what evidence would rule it out.

Here is a recursive descent parser that stack-overflows on deeply nested input. Rewrite it iteratively with an explicit stack, preserving exact error messages and positions. Then explain what changed about the error behaviour and why.

Estimate the total mass of all the copper in residential electrical wiring in a city of two million people. Show each assumption, give a range rather than a point estimate, and state which assumption dominates the uncertainty.

Design a cache that is strongly consistent across three regions, serves reads in under 5ms at p99 in all of them, and survives a full region partition without losing writes. If this is impossible, prove which pair of requirements conflicts and what the closest achievable design is.

A tank fills at 3.7 L/min and drains at 1.9 L/min for the first 40 minutes, then the drain is closed and the fill rate drops by 15%. The tank holds 250 L. When does it overflow? Show every intermediate value to two decimal places.

Restate the following problem in your own words, list what is being asked for, solve it, and then check your solution against your restatement: a train leaves A at 14:20 travelling at 82 km/h; a second leaves B, 340 km away, at 14:50 travelling toward A at 96 km/h. Where and when do they meet?
